utterances.speaker: Narrator
utterances.text: We don't know. Natural fires existed long before people.

utterances.speaker: Sol
utterances.text: Like when lightning hits a tree?

utterances.speaker: Narrator
utterances.text: Yes. Lightning's heat can set dry wood alight.

utterances.speaker: Narrator
utterances.text: Our ancestors could keep embers glowing by feeding them wood. Making fire themselves was a different skill.

utterances.speaker: Sol
utterances.text: So finding fire wasn't the same as making it.
